highlights: UGREEN 45763 QI2 Magnetic MagSafe Power Bank,10,000mAh QI2 Wireless Portable Charger, PD 20W Fast Charging

Designed for iPhone 17–12 Series: Built with a strong 10N magnet, this magnetic power bank securely attaches to the back of your iPhone 15 Pro Max without slipping or needing extra cables. For the best magnetic hold and wireless charging performance, please use a MagSafe-compatible case. Using thick, metal, or non-MagSafe cases may prevent the product from attaching properly or disable wireless charging. The well-fitted design also makes it easy to take selfies or video calls with one hand.

Double Power for the Whole Day: Equipped with a 10,000 mAh high-density Li-polymer battery, this power bank can fully charge an iPhone 15 Pro about 1.8–1.9 times under normal conditions. Actual results may vary depending on device model, charging environment, and usage habits. Ideal for all-day calls, videos, and music.

Skin-friendly & Slim: Made of soft silicone material, this charger provides a skin-friendly, comfortable touch while resisting fingerprints. Its compact 0.7-inch profile and smooth surface make it easy to hold or slip into a pocket. A slight surface warmth is normal during fast charging.

Wireless & Wired: Supports both MagSafe wireless charging and USB-C PD 20W fast charging. You can charge another phone by cable while wirelessly charging your iPhone. Please ensure your phone is using a MagSafe-compatible case to enable proper wireless charging. When charging multiple devices, the total output is intelligently shared to ensure safe operation.
Perfect Size: Weighing only 7.8 oz and measuring 4.2 × 2.7 × 0.7 in, this compact power bank fits easily in your pocket—ideal for travel and on-the-go use.

Reliable & Temperature-Controlled Charging: Built with advanced temperature and safety protection, this power bank maintains stable performance during use. A slight temperature rise during fast charging is normal and within safe limits, ensuring long-term reliability and peace of mind.
